reply: I did not find the exact law. My best candidate reached a training NMSE of about 1e-3, far from the 1e-12 target. The best candidate recorded from earlier attempts was 3.975e-4 (the sqrt(t)/log(P) polynomial form), and I used all 14 calls without beating it.

best.code:
import numpy as np
def equation(t,P,params):
    st=np.sqrt(t); sp=np.sqrt(P); lp=np.log(P)
    return (params[0]+params[1]*t+params[2]*st+params[3]*sp+params[4]*sp*t
            +params[5]*sp*st+params[6]*lp*st+params[7]*lp*t**2+params[8]*P*st+params[9]*P**2*st)
